Moving maintenance from the calendar to the condition

Move the scheduled budget into condition-based maintenance

[1]

Calendar maintenance keeps paying for downtime it cannot see coming; a condition view catches most stops before they happen.

Lead with the decision; the three slides after it carry the why, the cost and the how.

Today: maintenance by the calendar [1]
Fixed intervals, surprise failures; most stops announce themselves first and go unread.
Tomorrow: maintenance by the condition [4]
One view of every asset and one ranked list of alerts, so technicians act before the stop.

Keep both options on screen; the contrast between them is the argument.

Four costs stack on the same three-year horizon

Downtime dominates, and the three smaller costs compound it.

Read the largest bar first, then the three that compound it.

Three parts make one asset-health capability

Point at the dependencies: the ranking needs the view, and the documentation needs the ranking.
